subject: SOC 2 / GRC MAP: point people, evidence owners, and delivery roadmap
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@mediq.com>; Evan Ross <evan.ross@mediq.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 / GRC MAP: point people, evidence owners, and delivery roadmap

Hi Maya and Evan —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As discussed, we want to get a concise mutual action plan (MAP) in place so Mediq can complete your SOC 2 evaluation and our POC evaluation in parallel. To make the intake simple, I'm kicking off a short thread to confirm stakeholder roles and the evidence ownership model.

High-level ask for this thread:
- Confirm the primary GRC and data handling contacts on your side.
- Confirm the list of evidence artifacts you can provide and approximate delivery dates.
- Agree an initial MAP timeline so we can lock a target evaluation window.

My proposed internal owners (copied):
- Dylan Brooks — SOC 2 / evidence intake and engineering liaison.
- Marissa Cole — Customer success lead for onboarding & rollout plan.
- Vivek Kulkarni — Commercial owner for procurement and contract questions.

Mediq example ask: could you confirm who will be the GRC lead and the procurement contact we should loop in? If you already have a SOC 2 tracker, feel free to share — otherwise I attached a short evidence index template to make it quick.

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-index.xlsx (template), rdw-data-flow.png (example).

Proposed initial MAP milestones (high level):
1) Evidence intake complete — target 2 weeks
2) Technical access & POC infra verified — target 3 weeks
3) Eval window (smoke tests + regression) — 2 weeks
4) SOC 2 gap items reconciled — ongoing during eval

I'll follow up with a short calendar invite to align everyone for a 30-minute kickoff.

Thanks,

Hannah Schmitt
Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@mediq.com>

Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / GRC MAP: point people, evidence owners, and delivery roadmap

Thanks Hannah — this is great and timely. Quick answers from our side:

- Our GRC lead will be me (Maya Patel). I'll own evidence collection and single-point submission.
- Procurement contact: procurement@mediq.com (Karen Lopez is the PO owner; she'll reply separately on contracting cadence).
- We have a partial SOC 2 binder (last attestation 2025) and a spreadsheet of evidence objects. I'll attach our current tracker by end of day.

Timeline looks reasonable. Small request: can we extend "Evidence intake complete" to 3 weeks instead of 2? We have internal approvals to run for some items.

Happy to join a 30-minute kickoff — I see availability tomorrow at 10:30am PT if that works.

Best,

Maya Patel
Head of GRC, Mediq Health
maya.patel@mediq.com
+1 415-222-3344

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@mediq.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 / GRC MAP: point people, evidence owners, and delivery roadmap

Maya — thanks for the quick response and for taking point. We can accommodate the 3-week evidence intake window. Adjusted milestones below (I'll update the Drive MAP).

Updated proposed milestones:
- Evidence intake complete — 3 weeks (target: 2026-09-09)
- Technical access & POC infra verified — target: 2026-09-16
- Eval window (smoke tests + regression) — 2026-09-20 to 2026-10-04
- Final pre-contract checklist / SOC 2 notes reviewed — target: 2026-10-08

A couple of follow-ups / asks for the intake:
1) For any control evidence that references production logs, can you identify an archive retention window and the logging owner? Example line item we need: "authentication event logs (prod-auth-01) — owner: SRE team — retention: 90 days".
2) For data handling, please confirm whether PHI will be present in any PII examples we share during the POC. If yes, we'll execute an additional data processing addendum draft.

I've uploaded an updated MAP timeline and a lightweight evidence intake template here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-example-MAP

Thanks — I'll plan to review your MEDIQ_SOC2-tracker and annotate the required fields.

-Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
+dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com

Looping in Karen Lopez from procurement (procurement@mediq.com) to confirm contracting cadence. Karen — welcome. We expect a standard SOW + standard data processing addendum (if PHI is involved).

Maya — I attached the MEDIQ tracker you referenced — I've highlighted the items that will be slow (legal approvals on third-party subcontractors and audit log exports). We should be able to get the bulk of the evidence into you in the 3-week window.

Next steps:
- Karen will reply with procurement timeline.
- Maya to share final tracker (if updated) by EOD Monday 8/23.
